title: Einstein’s relativity: zero to hero (Galileo → GPS)
topic: Special and general relativity for curious adults
audience: A smart adult who never got it
governingThought: Relativity is the demand that the laws of physics look the same in every inertial frame while light’s speed in vacuum stays fixed — from that single tension, time dilation, E = mc², curved spacetime, and GPS corrections all follow.
takeaways: **Special relativity (1905):** Inertial frames + constant **c** ⇒ moving clocks run slow and simultaneity is frame-dependent ([Einstein 1905](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/andp.19053221004), [Stanford SEP](https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/spacetime-convensimul/)).

**General relativity (1915):** Gravity is geometry — mass-energy curves spacetime; free fall is geodesic motion ([Einstein Nov 25 1915 paper scan](https://echo-old.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/ECHOdocuView?pn=3&tocMode=none&url=%2Fpermanent%2Fecho%2Feinstein%2Fsitzungsberichte%2F6E3MAXK4%2Findex.meta)).

**GPS needs both:** Orbiting clocks gain ~**45 µs/day** (gravity) and lose ~**7 µs/day** (speed) ⇒ net ~**+38 µs/day** programmed in, or positions drift kilometers ([NIST TN 1385](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/Legacy/TN/nbstechnicalnote1385.pdf)).

What GPS actually does with relativity

blocks.text: An **inertial frame** is a reference frame with no net acceleration — a train at constant velocity counts; a spinning carousel does not. Galileo noted that below decks you cannot tell steady motion from rest: physics experiments give the same results ([Stanford SEP on simultaneity conventions](https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/spacetime-convensimul/) discusses how Einstein sharpened this).
Classically, velocities add: if you walk 5 km/h inside a train doing 100 km/h, ground observers see 105 km/h. Time and length were assumed absolute — every clock agrees on “now.”

blocks.title: Where classical physics breaks
blocks.text: Maxwell’s equations predict a fixed speed **c ≈ 299,792 km/s** for light in vacuum. If you chase a light beam, classical velocity addition says you should see a slower beam — experiments (and Einstein’s 1905 postulate) say you do not.

sections.title: Special relativity: c, time dilation, E = mc²

blocks.text: Einstein’s 1905 paper [*Zur Elektrodynamik bewegter Körper*](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/andp.19053221004) starts from two postulates: (1) physics laws are the same in all inertial frames; (2) **c** is the same in all inertial frames, independent of the source’s motion.

**Symbols you will see:** **c** = speed of light in vacuum; **v** = relative speed between frames; **t** = time in the “rest” frame; **t′** = time in the moving frame. The [Lorentz factor](https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/spacetime-convensimul/) γ = 1/√(1 − v²/c²) converts between frames.

**Time dilation:** A clock moving at speed **v** relative to you ticks slower by factor γ. Proper time Δτ on the moving clock relates to your elapsed time Δt via Δt = γ Δτ. At everyday speeds γ ≈ 1; at GPS satellite speeds the effect is small but measurable.

**E = mc²:** Einstein’s follow-on 1905 note showed mass and energy are equivalent — **E** is energy, **m** is rest mass, **c** links the units. A small mass defect converts to enormous energy because **c²** is huge. This is not “everything is light”; it is a statement about how much energy is stored in mass at rest.

**Simultaneity:** Einstein showed there is no absolute “now” for separated events — synchronizing distant clocks requires a convention (e.g., light-signal midpoint rule). That is why special relativity pairs space and time into **spacetime**.

By 1907 Einstein had the **equivalence principle**: in a small enough region, gravitational acceleration is indistinguishable from acceleration of your reference frame (elevator thought experiment). Gravity is not a force in the Newtonian sense acting at a distance — it is geometry.

In November 1915 Einstein presented the final **field equations** to the Prussian Academy. The decisive communication [*Die Feldgleichungen der Gravitation*](https://echo-old.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/ECHOdocuView?pn=3&tocMode=none&url=%2Fpermanent%2Fecho%2Feinstein%2Fsitzungsberichte%2F6E3MAXK4%2Findex.meta) (25 Nov 1915) completed the theory. Mass-energy tells spacetime how to curve; curved spacetime tells matter how to move.

**Curvature in plain language:** Parallel lines (geodesics) can converge — that is what we feel as gravity. The 1915 papers recovered the anomalous **Mercury perihelion precession**, which Newtonian gravity could not fully explain.

For deeper reading without hype: [Stanford Encyclopedia — Simultaneity and Conventionality](https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/spacetime-convensimul/), [Einstein Papers Project / MPIWG scans](https://echo-old.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/ECHOdocuView?pn=3&tocMode=none&url=%2Fpermanent%2Fecho%2Feinstein%2Fsitzungsberichte%2F6E3MAXK4%2Findex.meta), and undergraduate texts cited in [Springer’s historical volume on the November 1915 papers](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-030-97955-3).

sections.title: What GPS actually does with relativity

blocks.text: GPS satellites carry atomic clocks. Engineers must correct those clocks or range measurements drift kilometers per day. [NIST Technical Note 1385](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/Legacy/TN/nbstechnicalnote1385.pdf) walks through the corrections tied to the **constancy of c** and coordinate time definitions.

headers: Approx. daily clock shift (satellite vs ground)
rows: Weaker gravity higher up ⇒ clocks run faster
Satellite speed ⇒ moving clocks run slower
Combined SR + GR correction baked into clock rate

blocks.text: Receivers solve for position by comparing signal travel times from multiple satellites. If satellite clock rates ignored relativity, **c**-based ranging would systematically wrong — the [QuarkNet relativity+GPS handout](https://quarknet.org/sites/default/files/Relativity%20Einstein%20GPS.pdf) estimates order **~11 km/day** position error without corrections (order-of-magnitude teaching figure; operational systems include additional effects).

GPS is engineering proof that relativity is not merely philosophical — it is a required correction in the [Interface Control Document](https://www.gps.gov/technical/) time scale maintained by US Space Force / NIST traceability.
